source.text: Lyhyt artikkeli kertoo vain yhden pienen asian tässä kohdassa.

note: This paragraph is too short to compare.

sql.label: The article
sql.statement: SELECT lang, page_id, rev_id, wikidata_id, title, date_modified FROM article WHERE lang = ? AND page_id = ?

sql.label: The paragraph
sql.statement: SELECT p.para_id, p.kind, p.section, p.text, p.text_hash, p.citations, p.numbers, s.badge, s.badge_label, s.badge_reasons FROM paragraph p LEFT JOIN paragraph_signal s ON s.lang = p.lang AND s.page_id = p.page_id AND s.para_id = p.para_id WHERE p.lang = ? AND p.page_id = ? AND p.para_id = ?

sql.label: Has history
sql.statement: SELECT rev_id, user, row_start AS saved_at FROM article_history WHERE page_id = ?

sql.label: The article
